branches.label: Bank offices (FDIC Summary of Deposits)
branches.period: as of June 30, 2024 (2024 Summary of Deposits survey)
branches.definition: Number of insured-bank office records (main office plus branches) reported in the FDIC Summary of Deposits for Bank of America, N.A. (FDIC cert 3510) and Bank of America California, N.A. (cert 25178), combined by the FDIC query, aggregated by branch state (STALPBR) by the FDIC BankFind API ('count').

deposits.label: Deposits held in offices in the state (FDIC Summary of Deposits)
deposits.period: as of June 30, 2024 (2024 Summary of Deposits survey)
deposits.definition: Sum of branch-office deposits (DEPSUMBR, reported in $ thousands, converted to millions) for Bank of America, N.A. (FDIC cert 3510) and Bank of America California, N.A. (cert 25178), combined by the FDIC query by branch state, as aggregated by the FDIC BankFind API ('sum_DEPSUMBR'). Deposits are assigned to the office where the bank books them, so main-office and booking-center states can be inflated relative to where depositors live.

footprint.notes: State rows come from two sources, so a state can appear twice with different metric keys: (1) FDIC Summary of Deposits, June 30, 2024 survey, aggregated server-side by the FDIC BankFind API by branch state for both Bank of America insured charters (cert 3510 and cert 25178, the single-office Bank of America California, N.A.); 'count' is office records and 'sum_DEPSUMBR' is deposits in $ thousands, stored in millions with a bracketed conversion. FDIC national totals for the query: 3,744 offices and $1,913,493,650 thousand. BofA has SOD offices in 38 states plus DC; states absent from the FDIC response have no BofA branch. (2) Bank of America 'Local Impact Fact Sheet' pages (resources.bankofamerica.com/local-market/fact-sheet/<market>) give 'Local employees'; only the 11 markets named for a state (AR, CO, DE, IA, KY, ME, NH, NJ, RI, UT, WI) are used; the fact sheets do not define market boundaries, and the other ~80 are metro markets. These pages are undated and current (2026). Wisconsin shows local employees but no FDIC branch offices. Not used: the 10-K states 78% of ~213,000 employees were in the U.S. at Dec 31, 2024 (no country breakdown, so no countries rows; the non-U.S. remainder would be a derivation). Sites are the four principal properties in 10-K Item 2.
